page.overview:
Who is Snake Eyes?

Snake Eyes is a dedicated member of the G.I. Joe team, but he is forced to put a personal issue first when his archenemy Storm Shadow raises their rivalry to a deadly new level. The G.I. Joe commando confronts the Cobra ninja in a duel that originated many years ago, when they were friends in a ninja school that taught the Seven Steps to the Sun, a lethal martial arts sequence. Snake Eyes has never revealed how many of these steps he learned... and the answer to this question will determine who lives and who dies in this final duel.

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Rise of Cobra

In 2009, Series 7 of the movie toys included a figure called "City Strike Snake Eyes." Although there is no notation on the packaging, the design is clearly based on the Resolute cartoon. ---- Appearance: dark grey torso with light gray pads on the shoulders; black gloves; black pants; gray kneepads; grey shinguards; gray boots; dark grey mask with gray goggles; red Arashikage symbol on right arm; dark grey webgear

Accessories: black XN-2 Ascension Pack with two grappling hooks on a string; black crampons; silver sword w/ black handle and grey scabbard; silver knife with black handle; black pistol; black G36 assault rifle; black submachine gun; small grey backpack. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/09/snakeeyes48.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/09/snakeeyes48.shtml Filecard]
